note: What a server sends to lay a new look over a unit's own. The header names the unit.

fields.name: entry
fields.note: Names this look, so that AppearancePopped can name it.

bits.name: overrideSpells
bits.note: Set where the unit's spells change with it.

bits.name: modelOnly
bits.note: Set where only the model changes.

bits.name: replacePackage
bits.note: Set where its art and sound change with it.

fields.name: asset
fields.note: The name the client loads it under, ended by a zero byte.
